passages.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sang this song while going up to Jerusalem.
David wrote this song.

passages.text: My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
David wrote this song.
David speaks to the LORD.
David says his heart is not proud.
David says his eyes are not haughty.
David does not seek great things.
David does not pursue matters too lofty for him.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה׀ לֹא־ גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־ רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־ הִלַּ֓כְתִּי׀ בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song of ascents.
David speaks to the LORD.
David says he has stilled his soul.
David says he has quieted his soul.
David’s soul is calm.
David’s soul is like a weaned child with his mother.
David’s soul rests within him like a weaned child.
passages.original: אִם־ לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי׀ וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣י נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
passages.sermon: Israel, trust in the LORD.\r\nBegin to hope in Him now.\r\nContinue to hope in Him forever.
passages.original: יַחֵ֣ל יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
